cards.card_text: Now he asks how a believer with a grievance against another dare go to law before the unrighteous, and friend, I think Paul is HOT about it.
cards.verse_text: If any of you has a grievance against another, how dare he go to law before the unrighteous instead of before the saints!
cards.snippet: …a grievance against another, how dare he go to law before the unrighteous instead of before the saints!

cards.card_text: Instead of the unrighteous, who does Paul say a believer with a grievance should bring it to?
cards.verse_text: If any of you has a grievance against another, how dare he go to law before the unrighteous instead of before the saints!
cards.snippet: …a grievance against another, how dare he go to law before the unrighteous instead of before the saints!

cards.card_text: Christ suffered as the righteous for the unrighteous.
cards.verse_text: For Christ also suffered for sins once for all, the righteous for the unrighteous, to bring you to God.
cards.snippet: …Christ also suffered for sins once for all, the righteous for the unrighteous, to bring you to God.

cards.card_text: Rescue the godly and hold the unrighteous for punishment Keep the godly from ever facing any trials Spare the unrighteous if a few godly remain
cards.verse_text: if all this is so, then the Lord knows how to rescue the godly from trials and to hold the unrighteous for punishment on the day of judgment.
cards.snippet: …knows how to rescue the godly from trials and to hold the unrighteous for punishment on the day of judgment.

cards.card_text: Then the angel says something heavy: "Let the unrighteous continue to be unrighteous, and the vile continue to be vile…" And he's not finished.
cards.verse_text: Let the unrighteous continue to be unrighteous, and the vile continue to be vile; let the righteous continue to practice righteousness, and the holy continue to be holy.”
